The '''1995 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 51st completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. Each team played 26 games with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number twelve, thirteen and fourteen are relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon|first division]] were promoted, as well as the winner of a play-off match between the two second placed teams in the two groups of the first division.
